goa.groove: Four-on-the-floor kick with a driving 16th-note bassline that plays every 16th, often with a gentle swing between notes
goa.structure: Long and evolving: intro 32 → main 64 → breakdown 32 → main 64 → outro 32. Tracks of 8–10 minutes are normal.
goa.sounds: Analog-style saw and square leads with portamento, TB-303 acid lines, oriental scales (Phrygian, harmonic minor), 909 hats and claps
goa.tip: Write the lead melody first and let the arrangement follow it: Goa is melody-driven. A 303 clone (e.g. ABL3, or FL's own 3x Osc with a resonant filter) gets you most of the way.
goa.plugins: Any analog-style synth: Sylenth1, Diva, Vital (free), FL 3x Osc for basses

oldschool.groove: Tighter, punchier kick than Goa; the 16th bassline gets more digital and aggressive
oldschool.structure: Shorter phrases than Goa, more frequent changes every 8–16 bars, sudden breaks and drops
oldschool.sounds: Squelchy acid, weird vocal samples and film quotes, zappy FX, less oriental melody
oldschool.tip: Humour is part of the style: a ridiculous sample in the right place is a feature, not a mistake.
oldschool.plugins: 303 emulations, samplers for vocal clips, FL Fruity Granulizer for glitchy textures

psy.groove: Kick plus a rolling bass starting to replace the 16th-note Goa bassline
psy.structure: Intro 32 → build 16 → main 32 → breakdown 32 → main 32 → outro 32
psy.sounds: Digital leads, lots of FX and automation, less melody and more sound design
psy.tip: Automate filter cutoff and resonance on almost everything: movement is what keeps a psy loop alive.
psy.plugins: Serum or Vital for leads and FX, Sylenth1 for basses

fullon.groove: Rolling bass: kick on every beat and three short bass notes in between (K-b-b-b). Kick and bass never overlap
fullon.structure: Intro 32 → build 16 → main 32 → breakdown 32 → build 16 → main 32 → outro 32, with a change every 8 or 16 bars
fullon.sounds: Big supersaw or pluck leads with glide, risers and white-noise sweeps before every drop, vocal samples in breakdowns
fullon.tip: Use a short-envelope saw for the bass, low-pass filter it, add slight distortion, and keep it in mono. Tune the kick tail to the key of the track.
fullon.plugins: Sylenth1 or Serum for bass and leads, Vital (free), light sidechain (Kickstart) or volume shaping on the bass

morning.groove: Classic full-on rolling bass, but softer and rounder in tone
morning.structure: Like full-on, with longer melodic breakdowns
morning.sounds: Major-key or uplifting melodies, bright pads, arpeggios, less aggressive FX
morning.tip: Try major or Lydian scales for the lead: that brightness is what separates morning from night full-on.

night.groove: Rolling bass with more distortion and a harder kick
night.structure: Full-on structure with shorter breakdowns and more tension builds
night.sounds: Dark leads, dense FX layers, screeches, fewer melodic themes
night.tip: Stack FX instead of melodies: short automated stabs and screeches every 2–4 bars keep the energy up.
night.plugins: Serum for FX, distortion (FabFilter Saturn, FL Fruity Blood Overdrive)

brazil.groove: Dense, loud rolling bass with a very compressed modern kick
brazil.structure: Festival-oriented: big build-ups and clear drops, shorter intros
brazil.sounds: Loud leads, vocal hooks, big risers and impacts
brazil.tip: Loudness and clarity matter here: spend time on kick–bass balance and master bus clipping.
brazil.plugins: Serum, Spire, clippers (StandardCLIP, FL Fruity Soft Clipper)

neogoa.groove: Goa-style 16th-note bassline with a modern, clean kick
neogoa.sounds: Acid lines, oriental melodies, analog-style leads, modern mixing
neogoa.tip: Treat it like Goa with today's mix quality: classic writing, modern low end.
neogoa.plugins: Diva, Sylenth1, ABL3 or other 303 emulations

mainstream.groove: Simplified rolling bass that drops out completely in breaks
mainstream.structure: EDM-style: short intro → build → drop → break → build → drop. Often 3–4 minute radio edits
mainstream.sounds: Vocals and ethnic chants, big leads, huge risers and impacts
mainstream.tip: Everything serves the drop: keep the main hook simple enough to sing.
mainstream.plugins: Serum, Spire, Nexus for quick leads and vocal chops

prog.groove: Off-beat bass (the bass plays on the 'and') or a shorter rolling bass, with heavy sidechain
prog.structure: Slow evolution: intro 32 → groove 64 → breakdown 32 → groove 64 → outro 32, with filter sweeps over 32–64 bars
prog.sounds: Deep round kick, hypnotic loops, minimal melodies, long pad swells
prog.tip: Automate one or two parameters very slowly across the whole track instead of adding new parts.
prog.plugins: Serum, Diva, FL Fruity Limiter or a dedicated ducking plugin for sidechain

zenon.groove: Short, percussive bass notes with lots of space, techno-style kick
zenon.structure: Minimal and loop-based, small changes every 8 bars
zenon.sounds: Glitches, micro-samples, dry percussion, odd FX
zenon.tip: Leave space: mute more than you add. The silence between bass hits is part of the groove.
zenon.plugins: Granular tools, FL Fruity Granulizer, Serum for clicky FX

psytechno.groove: Straight 4/4 techno kick with rumble bass underneath instead of a rolling bass
psytechno.structure: Techno-style: long grooves, tension through layering rather than drops
psytechno.sounds: Dark pads, psychedelic FX, acid details, hypnotic percussion
psytechno.tip: Make the rumble by sending the kick to a reverb, then filtering and sidechaining that reverb.
psytechno.plugins: Reverb + EQ for rumble, Serum, ABL3

twilight.groove: Rolling bass with groove and swing, medium-hard kick
twilight.structure: Between full-on and dark: tension builds, fewer drops
twilight.sounds: Dark melodies, mysterious atmospheres, more melody than darkpsy
twilight.tip: Use minor or diminished melodies over a groovy bass: dark mood, still danceable.

dark.groove: Fast, distorted rolling bass, hard kick
dark.structure: Abstract: constant changes, few classic breakdowns
dark.sounds: Horror samples, metallic textures, screams, granular noise
dark.tip: Resample constantly: bounce FX to audio, then mangle them again. That's where the weirdness comes from.
dark.plugins: Serum, granular samplers, distortion, FL Edison for resampling

suomi.structure: Chaotic on purpose: unexpected changes and breaks
suomi.tip: Break your own rules: try an odd bar length or a sudden tempo jump.

forest.groove: Rolling bass with organic textures, muffled earthy kick
forest.structure: Hypnotic and continuous, few big breakdowns
forest.sounds: Forest field recordings, rustling, insects, wooden percussion, mystical pads
forest.tip: Layer real nature recordings under the groove and automate their filters so they breathe.
forest.plugins: Field recordings, granular tools, convolution reverb

hitech.groove: Very fast rolling bass, often in 16ths, short sharp kick
hitech.structure: A change every 2–4 bars, constant micro-variation
hitech.sounds: Thousands of short FX hits, sci-fi sound design, glitches
hitech.tip: Program in small 1–2 bar blocks and vary every repetition; the piano roll zoomed way in is your friend.
hitech.plugins: Serum, FL Patcher for FX chains, transient shapers

psycore.groove: Fast, aggressive bass with an industrial kick
psycore.sounds: Noise, heavy distortion, industrial textures, horror samples
psycore.tip: Distortion is an instrument here; chain several in series and automate their drive.

psybient.groove: Soft or no kick, slow deep pads instead of a bassline
psybient.sounds: Vast reverbs, ethnic instruments, layered textures, field recordings
psybient.tip: Long reverb and delay tails are the instrument: automate their mix and size.

psyworld.groove: Ethnic percussion instead of a clean kick, organic bass
psyworld.structure: Song-like, often with vocal or instrumental themes
psyworld.tip: Record or sample real instruments and leave their imperfections in.

psydub.groove: Deep dub bass, slow soft kick, reggae offbeat skank
psydub.structure: Dub-style: elements drop in and out, echo throws
psydub.sounds: Delay with feedback, spring reverb, dub sirens, psychedelic FX
psydub.tip: Do 'dub throws': send single hits into a feedback delay and ride the send live.
psydub.plugins: Echo/delay (Valhalla Delay, FL Fruity Delay 3), spring reverb

psystep.groove: Half-time dubstep rhythm with wobble and sub bass
psystep.structure: Build and drop, like dubstep with psychedelic sections
psystep.sounds: Wobble bass, sub, psychedelic FX, ethnic details
psystep.tip: Automate an LFO on the filter for the wobble and sync it to 1/8 or 1/4 triplets.

psybass.groove: Broken breakbeat rhythms with heavy distorted bass
psybass.sounds: Glitches, micro-edits, spatial FX, heavy bass
psybass.tip: Chop and re-sequence audio at 1/32 resolution for those glitch fills.

nitzhonot.groove: Hard loud kick with a simple off-beat or galloping bass
nitzhonot.structure: Long uplifting builds into anthemic main sections
nitzhonot.sounds: Anthemic leads, Eastern scales, epic pads
nitzhonot.tip: Harmonic minor with a big supersaw lead gets you very close to the classic sound.

sapsy.groove: Rolling bass, from soft progressive to full-on weight
sapsy.structure: Varies with the artist: progressive builds or full-on structures
sapsy.sounds: Melodic themes, sunny festival energy, forest elements in the deeper corners
sapsy.tip: Listen to how melody and groove are balanced: neither dominates.

swedish.groove: Short, tight bass notes with heavy sidechain, deep minimal kick
swedish.structure: Hypnotic repetition with tiny filter changes
swedish.sounds: Minimal stabs, dubby delays, very little melody
swedish.tip: Try making a whole track from three sounds and filter automation only.
swedish.plugins: Simple subtractive synths, FL 3x Osc, delays

darkprog.groove: Deep, percussive, groovy bass with a dry hard kick
darkprog.structure: Progressive pacing with darker tension builds
darkprog.sounds: Dark pads, glitch and horror FX, lots of space
darkprog.tip: Use progressive arrangement with darkpsy sound design.

psybreaks.groove: Breakbeat drums instead of straight 4/4, psy rolling or acid bass on top
psybreaks.sounds: Psy FX and acid lines with funk/breaks groove
psybreaks.tip: Chop a classic break (Amen, Think) and lock its groove to your bassline.

offbeat.groove: Strict offbeat bass: kick on the beat, one short bass note on the 'and', with heavy sidechain
offbeat.structure: Intro 32 → groove 64 → melodic breakdown 32 → drop 64 → outro 32
offbeat.sounds: Punchy kick, offbeat bass, plucky arpeggios, a clear lead melody in the breakdown
offbeat.tip: Keep the bass note short and tuned to the kick so the two never overlap.
offbeat.plugins: Serum or Sylenth1 for the bass and leads, a ducking plugin for the sidechain
